subject: Liverpool have won once at Anfield in the league and failed to register a shot on target against Arsenal
title: Zero shots on target at Anfield

lines.vo: Zero shots on target at Anfield. Against Arsenal.
lines.footage: Liverpool vs Arsenal Anfield highlights, goalmouth

lines.vo: That had not happened in four hundred and forty-two league matches there.
Anfield, the fortress. Currently, the drawbridge is down.
One win from five at home. Only Crystal Palace and Nottingham Forest have fewer home points.
Away, they are the best in the division: four wins and a draw. Better guests than hosts.
Now Manchester United arrive: eighteenth, and winless in eight. They have not won at Anfield since March twenty twenty-three.

lines.vo: Shaky fortress, meet shaky visitor. Can Liverpool hit the target? Any target.

facts_used: In five home league games Liverpool have one win, two draws and two defeats; only Crystal Palace and Nottingham Forest have fewer home points (news 168, espn.com)
Against Arsenal they had no shot on target, the first such game in 442 league matches at Anfield (news 168)
Best away form in the division: four wins and a draw from five (news 168)
Man United arrive 18th and winless in eight league games; not won at Anfield since March 2023 (news 168)
notes: Source: news 168 (ESPN, 2026-11-20). Arsenal result is a home 1-0 loss per background; stated as in the data. No manager named: the Iraola quote is not tied to a confirmed role in the data.
